text:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (eu-west). p99=1.25s > SLO 1.0s. Page fired to eng-oncall + paging rotation.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-175777 - p99 latency spike - eu-west - page sent to alex (oncall).
alex (oncall): acked. I'm up — looking. night shift here, will triage.
maya (sre): seeing a spike in large-sequence requests and KV cache evictions around 1757769950. Could be cache churn after the midnight rollout window.
ryan (eng): checking runtime logs. Seeing many tail reqs hitting quantized model variant causing CPU-side encoding backlog. small snippet: ```2025-05-14T01:06:20Z worker-12 WARN kvcache: miss key=ctx-** large_seq=true```
ajax (ops-bot): autoscaler triggered +2 GPU pods at 1757770032. Added capacity but tail still high.
alex (oncall): routing rule: enabling eu-west fallback to ded-variant for 5m to reduce latency. Applying now. :gear:
maya (sre): good. Also reduce batch window from 40ms -> 20ms for inference pool id=prod-eu to prioritize latency. Pushing config change.
ryan (eng): confirming config applied: ```/config/inference: batch_ms: 20 -> applied by rbac:ops```
julia (pm): any customer impact? Should we open a status note?
maya (sre): minimal error count; customer-facing errors = 0. However tail latency for long responses increased — ~1.9% of requests > 3s in last 5m, up from 0.2%. Potential UX regressions for very long generations.
alex (oncall): rolling back last midnight non-critical tokenizer config in eu-west as a precaution. Initiating now.
ryan (eng): rollback command run: `deployctl rollback tokenizer-config eu-west --to=2025-05-13T23:59` — confirmed deployment finished 1757770088.
maya (sre): metrics trending down. p99 dropped to 0.92s at 1757770100. Keep watch 10m.
alex (oncall): will stay on thread for handoff. @maya, when I hand off to daytime rotation in 30m, can you take oncall if it reoccurs?
maya (sre): yes, I'll take it. I'll create a short runbook entry with checklist: check kvcache evictions, batch window, autoscaler events, and recent tokenizer commits.
julia (pm): adding a short status update to customers (no errors, mitigation in place, investigating root cause).
ops-bot: Note: incident auto-close scheduled if p99 < SLO for 15m.
alex (oncall): thanks team. Leaving monitoring checks active. Will post final handoff when I sign out. :wave:
